title: 트리즈엔, 차세대 SDN 컨트롤러에 양자내성암호(PQC) 통합 성공
title_en: TrizN integrates post-quantum cryptography (PQC) into its next-generation SDN controller
body: 국민대학교 교수 연구팀이 양자내성암호 알고리즘 ML-KEM을 TLS 1.3 핸드셰이크에 적용한 PQC-TLS 라이브러리를 자체 구현하고, 트리즈엔 상용 제품 적용에 성공했다.
body_en: A Kookmin University research team implemented a PQC-TLS library applying the ML-KEM post-quantum algorithm to the TLS 1.3 handshake, and successfully applied it to TrizN's commercial products.

bodyHtml_en: A Kookmin University research team implemented a PQC-TLS library applying the ML-KEM post-quantum algorithm to the TLS 1.3 handshake, and successfully applied it to TrizN's commercial products.
